root_cause: Omgevingsradar showed scores and URLs without a per-signal next step; buttons carrying data-open-page on the action shortlist did not have click handlers. Candidate suggestions were not visibly distinct from a tenant-specific actual action.
fix: Reuse tenant-scoped portal-state-eu signal_key and actionCandidates; show exact tenant action if source-current and relevant, otherwise explicit context/source review. Bind existing portal open-page callbacks. No extra AI, scheduler, CRM, customer write, invented outcome or public URL from untrusted protocol.
prevention_rule: No customer action navigates unless same exact signal_key, TENANT overlay, SCORED impact, source publication <=45d, observation <=7d and current deadline; canonicals remain review-only.
terminal_rule: Exact-head Required/CodeQL, protected merge, Netlify production revision, authenticated tenant portal action click/readback; no claims of lead/order/revenue without downstream evidence.
